list: createCustomerAppCoreWithPersistence: legacy default touches no database, then a real cutover and an application insert with no explicit parity metadata commits one row per table with a frozen canonical record

createCustomerAppCoreWithPersistence: repeating the default idempotency fingerprint after a real application insert rejects with CustomerIdempotencyConflictError and rolls back to exactly one row per table
createCustomerAppCoreWithPersistence: a partial explicit parity metadata set is fail-closed rejected with TypeError and leaves zero rows in every table (frozen P14b all-or-nothing rule)

red.reason: partial explicit parity metadata (one of audit/transactionalOutbox/idempotency explicitly supplied, others absent) was silently completed with defaults inside customer-data-cutover.mjs instead of being passed through unchanged for createCustomerPersistenceAdapter to fail-closed reject before any table write

capabilityDelta.before: In `consumers/customer-app-core/customer-data-cutover.mjs`, the application-path insert always built `parityOptions` by defaulting each of `audit`, `transactionalOutbox` and `idempotency` independently with `??`. A caller who explicitly supplied only one of the three (leaving the other two absent) got those two silently synthesized with Kernel-default values instead of the whole call being rejected, so `createCustomerPersistenceAdapter`'s all-or-nothing explicit-parity validation never saw the partial input it was designed to reject.
capabilityDelta.after: The application-path insert now decides synthesis as a single all-or-nothing gate: only when `audit`, `transactionalOutbox` and `idempotency` are all absent/undefined does it synthesize all three Kernel-parity defaults exactly as before; the moment any one of the three is explicitly supplied, none are defaulted and the full explicit `insertOptions` object (including any partial subset) is passed through unchanged to `createCustomerPersistenceAdapter`, which fail-closed rejects an incomplete explicit set with a `TypeError` before any table write. Legacy branch, connection/pool handling, tenant-context BEGIN/SELECT mfk_begin_tenant_context/COMMIT/ROLLBACK/release, cutover/rollback/close, complete explicit metadata pass-through, and every existing default value are byte-identical to before.
capabilityDelta.notRunnable: This package closes one fail-closed validation gap inside an already-explicit opt-in application cutover branch, proven against one real PostgreSQL container. It wires no live entrypoint, host, Surface, relay, release, deploy or automatic cutover trigger. P14 remains active; this is not a P14 completion claim.

owner.once: Gecis kolu (cutover) acikken, uygulama tarafindan cagiran biri iz kaydi (audit), kuyruk (transactionalOutbox) ve tekrar-onleme (idempotency) bilgisinin sadece bir kismini acikca verdiginde, sistem eksik kalan kismi sessizce kendi varsayilanlariyla tamamliyor ve yaziyordu; oysa bu, cagiranin farkinda olmadan yanlis/eksik bir iz veya kuyruk kaydiyla veri yazilmasina yol acabilirdi.
owner.simdi: Artik kural nettir: cagiran uc alanin da (audit, transactionalOutbox, idempotency) hicbirini vermezse sistem hepsini eskisi gibi otomatik tamamlar; ama cagiran bunlardan herhangi birini acikca verirse, sistem artik hicbirini tamamlamaz ve eksik kalan diger alanlar varsa islemi tabloya hicbir satir yazmadan acik bir hatayla reddeder.
owner.fark: Once kismi acik bilgi sessizce tamamlanip yaziliyordu; simdi kismi acik bilgi, hicbir satir yazilmadan once acik bir hatayla durduruluyor. Tum-yok ya da tum-acik kurali artik gercekten uygulaniyor.
owner.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir CRM/HRMS formunun 'musteri kaydet' akisinda: gecis kolu kapaliyken davranis degismedi (legacy yol). Gecis kolu acikken ve cagiran hicbir ek bilgi vermezse davranis degismedi (otomatik tamamlama devam ediyor). Cagiran iz/kuyruk/tekrar-onleme bilgisinin sadece bir kismini acikca verirse, kayit artik yarim bilgiyle sessizce yazilmiyor; acik, tekrar denenebilir bir hata donuyor ve hicbir tabloya satir yazilmiyor.
